name: zamua
description: Zamua's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Issue-board-driven orchestration of local Claude Code worker agents: label an issue (sources: GitHub or Linear) and a local poller spawns a worker in a pane (runtimes: tmux or herdr) that works in a per-issue worktree and opens a draft PR; you review and merge.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram forum-topic agent router: multiplex one bot token across concurrent Claude Code conversations, plus opt-in harness-locked Google Antigravity topics in persistent Herdr sessions with dynamic subscription model and effort selection.

plugins.name: reexplain
plugins.description: Re-explain what you just said, for a reader who is not a domain expert. Rebuilds the explanation from first principles instead of compressing it: defines each term on first use, keeps the domain's own vocabulary, runs one concrete example all the way through, and separates what is settled from what is broken from what nobody has decided.

plugins.name: pr-review-board
plugins.description: React to a pull request with an emoji and a background Claude reviews it: a local poller spawns one review agent per changeset in its own herdr workspace, which writes the review to a board drawn in a /reviewboard pane beside it, a plain-English report linked to the code it calls out and the numbered comments it proposes. It posts only the ones you pick. Approves only when you say so, never pushes.

plugins.name: briefme
plugins.description: Write a very short brief on the state of the current work: one paragraph on what is going on, then only the questions and decisions that need the user. Use when the user has lost the thread of a long session, is returning after a break, or wants to know what needs them before doing anything else.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: A board pane beside the chat that Claude keeps current through the session, so nothing has to be asked for twice: the goal, where things stand, next steps, open questions, decisions, links, ideas and topics. Each session keeps its own board, restored on resume. /board opens it.

plugins.name: my-pr-board
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat tracking the pull requests this session raised: each stack bottom first, with GitHub's live state for every pull request, draft or ready, merged or closed, CI, conflicts, review and the threads waiting on you, plus Claude's one-line note on what is left. Pull requests opened with gh pr create join on their own. Each session keeps its own board, restored on resume. /myprs opens it.
